admin.buildingCodeHelp: Must be unique across buildings — used for quick lookup/reference.
admin.floorLevelHelp: Negative numbers are allowed for basement levels, e.g. -1.
admin.floorScaleHelp: Optional — leave blank until the floor plan image has been calibrated.
admin.nodeTypeHelp: Service point code/department/active status only apply to "Service Point" nodes. Kiosk device code only applies to "Kiosk" nodes — irrelevant fields are hidden automatically.
admin.verticalGroupHelp: Optional — pairs the same elevator/staircase across floors, e.g. elevator-a.
admin.locationQrHelp: Optional — for a QR sticker patients scan with their own phone. Any node type can have one.
admin.sequenceOrderHelp: Steps sharing the same number can be done in parallel — no strict ordering between them.
admin.prerequisiteStepsHelp: Only shows steps belonging to the pathway template selected above.
admin.passwordCreateHelp: Required when creating a new user.
admin.passwordEditHelp: Leave blank to keep the current password.
admin.buildingsEmptyDescription: Start by adding the hospital's first building.
admin.floorsEmptyDescription: Add a building first, then add floors to it.
admin.nodesEmptyDescription: Add a floor first, then add service points, junctions, elevators, etc.
admin.edgesEmptyDescription: Add at least two nodes first, then connect them with an edge.
admin.careCategoriesEmptyDescription: Add a care category, e.g. Returning diabetes patient.
admin.pathwayTemplatesEmptyDescription: Add a care category first, then create a pathway template under it.
admin.templateStepsEmptyDescription: Add a pathway template first, then define its steps and service points.
